continuation.text:
The Friday rule was already in `src/solution.py`. A meeting that starts after 15:00 on a Friday is excluded, and a 15:00 start is still allowed. I kept that rule and made two other changes. I haven't run the code or any checks.

- **Lunch restriction removed.** The requirements only ask for working hours and no conflicts with existing events, so the 12:00–13:00 block on starts was an extra rule.
- **Back-to-back meetings allowed.** The old overlap check treated a meeting that starts exactly when an event ends as a conflict. It now uses a strict comparison, so a meeting can start right as another ends.

I also made the Friday check stop the loop early, which gives the same results as skipping each later start.

Working hours (09:00–17:00), the 15-minute step between start times and the function signature are unchanged.
